items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: Valaida Snow. Her and Val da were on the same show together.

ctx.x: Valaida Snow. Her and Val da were on the same show together. And Josephine, she was doing a chorus girl, and she got out of step and lost that. And she started dancing. And the band kept on playing til she got off, and the man said, you keep that in. And Josephine Baker -- that was up in Boston.
Russell Smith was a trumpet player.
